findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.citation_text:
6-501.11 Repairing. PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair. 

The following physical facilities are observed to still need repaired from the pre-opening: 

1. REPEAT- Repair the flooring that is peeled at the door in the men’s room. 
2. REPEAT- Seal wood around floor drain of triple sink. 
3. Repair hole in wall of men’s restroom. 
4. REPEAT- Seal wood base/kick on right side of double sink in kitchen. 

Ensure that all physical facilities are repaired and are maintained in good repair.
